title: Class-II sharp-cube source-square reduction
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and the A7-A11 strict sharp rectangular-cube filtration, the adapted source satisfies sum_j ||G_j^* B(P_<=j-1 phi) D P_<=j-1 phi||_2^2 <= C_src ||phi||_6^6, where C_src=(beta_op^2/c_sym) M_R^2 M_6^4 Q_6^2, beta_op=4(a+2b+c), and M_6,Q_6 are the precisely defined cutoff-uniform Hilbert-valued sharp-cube L6 maximal and exact-weight derivative-prefix square-function norms.
scope: PROVED-ANALYTIC-REDUCTION@FIXED-FLOOR-SHARP-CUBE on L=16 for the A1 production coefficients, three complex components in the six-real convention, rho_regularizer=1e-12, a common real-even scalar regulator with supremum M_R, and the strict sharp rectangular-cube dyadic filtration. The Pauli/Fierz operator constant and exact shell decay are pinned numerically; the harmonic norms are proved finite but do not yet have a certified decimal enclosure, so T-047 and the production sextic budget remain open.
falsifier: Failure of the Pauli identities |m|^2=s^2 or m dot J=s ds; a field or variation violating 0<=B(psi)<=4(a+2b+c)|psi|^2 I_6 at the fixed floor; a wrong N_(j-1)+1 shell boundary, physical 2pi/L factor, covariance convention, derivative-direction factor, or M_R^2 regulator power; failure of the strict-dyadic periodic product-Marcinkiewicz hypotheses or the alternative six-linear face variation; a claimed decimal M_6^4 Q_6^2 without a certified enclosure; or any authority hash, PDF QA, non-importing, assertion-count, or cross-route failure falsifies the pinned reduction.

reproduction.expected: PASS: primary (26/26); PASS: independent (19/19); ASSERTS: 65/65; A12-CLASSII-SOURCE-SQUARE-REDUCTION-INTEGRATED-PASS; exit 0.

legacy_evidence: claims/A12-CLASSII-SOURCE-SQUARE-REDUCTION/notes/classii-source-square-reduction-260721-v1.0.pdf (5 pages; FORM-CHECK PASS; 0 overfull; visual QA PASS)
no_overclaim: This claim does not provide a certified decimal enclosure of M_6^4 Q_6^2, complete T-047, establish a positive production sextic reserve, prove the true-increment stabilised log-Laplace estimate, close the A7 self-coupled Nelson theorem, construct the interacting full three-component measure, remove the floor or regulator, take infinite volume, prove a phase transition or BCC selection, or justify T5, T6, or T7.
next_action: Close A12-CLASSII-SHARP-CUBE-L6-VECTOR-NORM-ENCLOSURE by producing a certified admissible upper bound for H_6=M_6^4 Q_6^2 and comparing it with 29.62571266025876 at p=1.1 for M_R=1. Then recompute all determinant, relative-form, quartic, and sextic budgets before revisiting the A11 stabilised log-Laplace gate.
notes: T4 PROVED-ANALYTIC-REDUCTION. The exact production Pauli/Fierz constant is beta_op=0.0423749999999894, the exact one-G source scaling is M_R^2, and beta_op^2/c_sym=0.016570372383568618. The cutoff-uniform sharp-cube vector theorem is proved by smooth-plus-annular product-Marcinkiewicz analysis and cross-checked by a six-linear multiplier route. Primary 26/26, non-importing independent 19/19, and integrated 65/65 pass. Numerical H_6 enclosure and the production budget remain open.
